Canelo Alvarez Wins WBC Super Middleweight Title from Christian Mbilli

Canelo Alvarez defeated Christian Mbilli by unanimous decision to regain the WBC super middleweight title. The fight saw Alvarez secure a vital win, keeping his career prospects strong after dominating Mbilli.
